sql_templates.template:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (qr.symbol) qr.symbol, qr.opm_pct, qr.revenue, ra.growth_yoy_revenue_pct, ra.growth_yoy_pat_pct, ra.verdict, ss.stage 
FROM scores.quarterly_results qr 
JOIN scores.results_analysis ra ON qr.symbol = ra.symbol AND qr.period_end = ra.period_end 
JOIN scores.stage_snapshots ss ON qr.symbol = ss.symbol 
WHERE qr.period_type = 'quarter' 
  AND qr.period_end = (SELECT MAX(period_end) FROM scores.quarterly_results) 
ORDER BY qr.symbol, qr.period_end DESC NULLS LAST, qr.fetched_at DESC 
LIMIT 10;

synthesis_guidance: ['Compare PAT and revenue growth percentages to determine strong performances.', 'Highlight any significant margin movements or operational risk areas.']

sql_templates.description: Construct sector-relative comparison for incremental add/trim decisions.
sql_templates.sql: WITH latest_stage AS ( SELECT * FROM scores.stage_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots) ), holding_details AS ( SELECT h.symbol, h.qty, h.avg_cost, s.sector, s.trading_signal FROM portfolio.holdings h JOIN latest_stage s ON h.symbol = s.symbol ) SELECT sector, SUM(qty) AS total_qty, AVG(avg_cost) AS avg_sector_cost, COUNT(CASE WHEN trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY') THEN 1 END) AS add_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN trading_signal IN ('SELL') THEN 1 END) AS trim_count FROM holding_details GROUP BY sector ORDER BY sector;
